notes: Track of Meitav's investment provident fund "מיטב גמל להשקעה", fund (קופה) number 7857 (flyer p.3; merger notice). Old name(s) until 30.6.2024, same track number (flyer p.3, CAT-13, CAT-26): מיטב גמל להשקעה מסלול אג״ח; מיטב גמל להשקעה מסלול אג"ח עד 10% מניות. The second old name belonged to track 7981, which merged into 7862 on 1.7.2024 (merger notice; CAT-13); 7981 is no longer in the regulator's list, so a statement showing that name maps here. The flyer prints the first old name with the gershayim character (אג״ח). Listed under the page's group "מסלולים ללא מניות".
